text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein chairs cabinet meeting and urges his ministers to combat negative aspects in society.
- More calls for the lifting of trade sanctions on Iraq.
- Letter from Iraqi foreign minister to his Egyptian counterpart.
- Indonesia opens medical fair in Baghdad.
- Jordan backs efforts leading to the removal of the embargo.
(The above were also carried by JUMHOURIYA and AL-IRAQ)
- Editorial praises the return of Hong Kong to China.
- Article on prospects open to Turkey in future.
- Mass arrests in both Sulaimaniya and Arbil.
- Italian firms ready to cooperate with Iraq.
- Preparations under way to transport passengers between Baghdad and Damascus.
- Editorial says the handover of Hong Kong to china is an indication that American dreams will never materialise.
- Farmers have the option of shipping their produce either to state silos or local markets.
